items.q: Olivierri, Anton Olivierri ... and young people I've met and the great musicians that I've met along the way

ctx.x: McKinney's Cottonpickers, that was the name in those days. That's just as plain as that was. So, back to Mr. Olivierri Langford teaching and Olivierri, Anton Olivierri ... and young people I've met and the great musicians that I've met along the way but they're talking a lot of things. But the

thing that could happen really and truly I think was appreciated of that one note, appreciating what the guy is writing. Now the difference comes with a bit of knowledge. The guy knows, well, look that's what I said. Now you can't show me. That's where I think Henderson and I always got together.
